overrides_applied.reason: DATA_GAP:capex — capex missing for FY2023, FY2024, FY2025 under every candidate tag the engine reads because, as a specialty P&C insurer, AFG reports no capital expenditures at all: its cash deployment (purchases of investments) is an investing activity for the insurance portfolio, and it carries no operating PP&E base on the balance sheet. The filing's own cash-flow reconciliation proves the capex amount is $0, not an undisclosed purchase (EG/CMPS-style proof). The engine's history already carried capex as assumed-zero, so the override changes no OE figure — it converts a silent zero-fill into a sourced, registered decision.
